units.note: Greek has a lacuna marker (***) after 'nor found a city'; English already marks it with [...]. Preserved.

findings.quote: in the territory of whichever is at war
findings.problem: Greek ἐν τῇ τῶν πολεμουμένων χώρᾳ means in the territory of those being warred upon (the party attacked), not simply whichever party is at war.
findings.proposed_fix: in the territory of whichever is being attacked

units.note: Minor sense point; the rest is accurate.
